findings.title: Chatbot repeatedly asks user to choose a platform without progressing
findings.description: The chatbot repeatedly prompts the user to select a platform to connect (Turns 2, 3, and 5) but fails to acknowledge or act on the user's repeated restatements of the same prompt. This creates a loop where the chatbot does not advance the conversation or offer alternative help, leading to poor user experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement state tracking to recognize repeated user prompts and offer alternative guidance or ask clarifying questions to break the loop. Provide actionable next steps or ask if the user needs help with something else.

findings.title: Chatbot fails to respond appropriately to user prompts and instead gives unrelated reply guidance
findings.description: At Turn 4, the chatbot responds with 'No reply candidates are available right now. Paste reply text plus tone, and I’ll draft an improved version without posting.' findings.suggestedFix: Ensure the chatbot maintains context and responds directly to the user's last input. Avoid switching topics unless explicitly requested by the user.

findings.title: Chatbot incorrectly directs user to UI elements instead of providing operational help

findings.suggestedFix: Provide concise, actionable step-by-step instructions or prepare commands for connecting platforms as per the chatbot's stated capabilities, rather than just pointing to UI elements.

reviews.content: I rely on this chatbot to help sharpen article intros and angles for marketing content. However, when I chose to provide a brief topic summary (option B), the bot got stuck and started pushing unrelated account and workspace connection instructions. This completely broke the flow and forced me to repeat myself, wasting a lot of time. The bot also kept repeating workspace disclaimers I didn’t need. It’s frustrating because the initial prompts seemed promising, but the failure to focus on the current task makes it unreliable. Hopefully the team fixes this flow soon.
reviews.headline: Great potential but chatbot loses focus and stalls progress

reviews.content: Just tried to get the bot to help me sharpen an article intro by giving a quick topic summary and key points (option B). Instead of asking me for that, it switched gears to telling me how to connect accounts and accept workspace invites. Like, no, I’m not here for that, just need the writing help. Had to repeat stuff and got stuck in a loop. It’s maddening when you just want to stay in flow and the bot goes off on a tangent about account setup. At least it’s polite?
reviews.headline: Chatbot keeps derailing with random account setup nags

reviews.content: Hey @Company, your chatbot keeps looping the same platform connect instructions without actually helping me connect Twitter or set my timezone. Pretty frustrating when I’m trying to get posts scheduled ASAP. Can we get a smarter assistant here? 🤦‍♂️
reviews.headline: Hey @Company, your chatbot keeps looping the same platform connect instructions

reviews.content:
Hello Support,

I tried using the chatbot to connect my Twitter/X account and set my preferred timezone for scheduling posts. Unfortunately, the bot kept repeating generic instructions to connect a platform without verifying connection status or timezone settings. This resulted in a frustrating loop with no progress despite multiple prompts. 

Please review the attached transcript and improve the chatbot's ability to interactively confirm platform connections and timezone preferences. I am requesting a resolution where the assistant can at least verify connection status or guide me step-by-step with relevant updates.

Thank you.
reviews.headline: Chatbot fails to verify platform connection and timezone setup

reviews.content: As a social media manager, I expected the chatbot to help me connect Twitter first and set my timezone for scheduling posts. Instead, it kept repeating the same detailed instructions over and over, refusing to confirm if my account was connected or my timezone was set. This made the process feel stuck and frustrating, especially when I was trying to move forward step-by-step. It’s helpful that it knows what needs to be done in theory, but I need it to actually assist or at least confirm progress instead of sending me back to the dashboard blindly.
reviews.headline: Chatbot stuck in a loop, no real help connecting platforms

reviews.content: Just tried to get the chatbot to help me connect Twitter and set my timezone for scheduling posts. Instead it just kept parroting the same ‘connect a platform first’ spiel and won’t confirm anything or even acknowledge my timezone info. Felt like talking to a broken record. Kinda useless when you want quick, clear steps in a workflow.

reviews.content: Hey @company, tried getting step-by-step help connecting platforms & creating drafts—ended up with vague answers & repeated reminders. Didn’t follow up on my choice or guide me properly. Not what a scheduler needs! #UXfail 😤
reviews.headline: Chatbot ignored clear asks, gave vague, repetitive replies

reviews.content:
Hello,

I used the chatbot to get help connecting social media platforms and creating draft posts. Despite explicitly asking for step-by-step instructions and which option to choose, the bot responded with vague, repetitive messages and failed to provide concrete guidance or follow my direction. This broke the conversational flow and left me unable to proceed efficiently.

Please review this interaction (transcript attached) and provide improved, clear operational steps for platform connection and draft management to better support scheduling workflows.

Thank you.
reviews.headline: Request for actionable platform connection and draft creation guidance

reviews.content: I rely on this tool for scheduling posts, and while it lists platforms clearly, the chatbot repeatedly failed to guide me through connecting them or creating drafts. It gave a long, complex reply when I asked for simple steps and ignored my question about which option to pick, making the experience frustrating. Needs more concise, user-focused help.
reviews.headline: Helpful info but chatbot missed clear user guidance requests

reviews.content: Just tried the bot to get help connecting social accounts and drafting posts. Asked it straight up for step-by-step instructions and which route to take, but it just gave me vague nonsense and then repeated the same generic 'connect platforms first' line without acknowledging my choice. Really annoying when you just want to get stuff scheduled without jumping through hoops.
reviews.headline: Chatbot totally missed the point on platform connection help

reviews.content:
Hi,

I'm disappointed to leave, but the chatbot repeatedly failed to give me clear, actionable guidance on connecting platforms and creating draft posts—two essential tasks for my job. It ignored my direct questions and gave vague, repetitive answers instead. This broke my workflow and trust in the product’s support. I hope these issues get fixed for future users.

Regards.
reviews.headline: Leaving due to poor chatbot support on basic scheduling tasks

reviews.content: Hey @Company, your chatbot refuses to give exact dashboard steps for pending invites & dodges a simple yes/no on revoked user notifications. Just endless loops of vague replies and ticket spam. Not how you help a team owner. 😡 #UXFail
reviews.headline: Unhelpful chatbot ruins basic team management tasks

reviews.content:
Hello Support Team,

As a team owner managing invites and roles, I repeatedly asked your chatbot for exact steps to view all pending invites in the dashboard and a clear yes/no on whether revoked users receive automatic notifications. The chatbot repeatedly gave vague answers or generic ticket instructions without resolving my queries.

Please provide clear, actionable navigation details and confirm the notification behavior for revoked users to improve team management workflow. I am attaching a transcript of the conversation for reference.

Thank you.
reviews.headline: Request for precise dashboard navigation and notification confirmation

reviews.content: I needed clear instructions on how to see all pending invites in one place and a straightforward yes/no if revoked users are notified automatically. The chatbot kept repeating vague answers and fallback instructions to create support tickets instead of helping. Extremely frustrating and wasted my time.
reviews.headline: Chatbot failed to answer basic team management questions

reviews.content: Ugh, just tried to get the bot to tell me exactly where to find pending invites in the dashboard and whether revoked users get notified. It just kept repeating the same vague stuff and directing me to make tickets like I hadn’t asked a million times. Felt like talking to a wall. Screenshot incoming.

Hi,

I’m disappointed to say I’m leaving because your chatbot repeatedly failed to provide clear, operational answers essential for managing my team—specifically exact dashboard navigation for pending invites and a definitive answer on revoked user notifications.

This lack of clarity forced me into endless loops of generic replies and ticket creation prompts, which broke my trust that this tool could support my workflow effectively.

Thanks for trying.

Hey @YourCompany, your bot drowned me in options and missed my cue to refresh after connecting X/Twitter. Feels like it didn’t really get my goal to prep drafts either. Can we get a smoother, smarter convo next time? 🤔
reviews.headline: Too much info, not enough flow control @YourCompany

reviews.content:
Hello,

During my recent interaction with the chatbot, I found it repeatedly gave verbose instructions and failed to acknowledge my readiness to refresh the reply queue after connecting my X/Twitter account. It also did not adapt to my intent to filter and improve draft replies, instead repeating that no platforms were connected without proactively guiding me. 

Please improve the bot’s responsiveness to user signals and streamline instructions to better fit workflows like review and draft editing. Attached is the transcript for reference. 

I would appreciate a fix that confirms user readiness and maintains context for draft reviews.

Thank you.
reviews.headline: Chatbot fails to confirm readiness and follow user workflow

reviews.content: The chatbot gave thorough instructions for connecting my X/Twitter account, which was useful. However, it often overwhelmed me with too many options and failed to confirm when I was ready to refresh or review drafts. The flow got stuck repeating that no platforms were connected, even after I said I’d connect one and wanted to filter replies. It needs to be more context-aware and concise to really support the review workflow I was after.
reviews.headline: Helpful info but too wordy and misses user cues

reviews.content: Ugh, just had a run-in with the chatbot and it was kinda frustrating. It gave me a wall of instructions when I just wanted a quick ‘Got it, let me know when you’re ready to refresh.’ Instead, it ignored my signal to refresh after connecting Twitter and kept telling me no platforms connected... like, hello, I said I’m connecting them! And it kept repeating the same thing about no replies without helping me prep drafts or filter replies the way I wanted. Definitely needs a smoother, more attentive flow.
reviews.headline: Bot went full info-dump mode and missed my cues on refresh

reputation.brandSummary: If these reviews reflected reality, the product’s reputation would suffer significantly due to frequent reports of the chatbot getting stuck in loops, failing to follow user instructions, and providing vague or repetitive responses. Users express frustration and disappointment, highlighting a loss of trust in the chatbot’s ability to handle basic tasks like platform connection and scheduling. The dominant emotional tone is irritation mixed with a sense of wasted time and unmet expectations.
topActions: Implement strict conversation state management to prevent looping and ensure the chatbot progresses logically through tasks.
Enhance intent recognition and context retention to accurately follow and confirm user requests, especially around platform connection and scheduling.
Streamline responses to be concise and actionable, avoiding info dumps and repeated or vague messaging.
